entities.summary: Sandister Tei is a Ghanaian media professional who was named the Wikimedian of the Year in October 2020 by Wikipedia co-founder Jimmy Wales during Wikimania 2020. She is a co-founder and dedicated volunteer of the Wikimedia Ghana User Group.
